question: What chapter and position in the text does this colophon identify?
premises: The colophon refers to the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text.
It names the chapter on seven-storey arrangement.
It identifies this as the thirty-third chapter.
inference: This is the thirty-third chapter, on seven-storey arrangement, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, on the arrangement of seven storeys, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
